text: Do not turn left or right at the intersection, depending on the sign.
Where a left-turn prohibition is displayed, you may proceed straight or turn right. Where a right-turn prohibition is displayed, you may proceed straight or turn left.
Do not turn your vehicle around so that it faces the opposite direction.
If sign R214 or TR214 is displayed, do not overtake any vehicle for the next 500m. If you are driving a heavy motor vehicle, do not overtake another heavy vehicle if sign R215 is displayed.
Do not park where these signs are displayed.
Do not stop unless to obey a traffic light or a traffic officer or to avoid a collision.
Despite the fact that pedestrians are prohibited on such a road, you must still look out for them. Pedestrians may not enter or cross a road where this sign is displayed.
Look out for cyclists who use the road despite the prohibition. Cyclists must follow a different route and may not proceed beyond this sign.
Look out for cyclists and pedestrians who use the road despite the prohibition. Cyclists and pedestrians must follow a different route and may not proceed beyond this sign.
Motorcyclists may not enter this part of the carriageway, or if this sign is displayed on a freeway, motorcyclists must leave at the first exit.
